column.name: fk_oauth_client
column.description: Identifier of the OAuth client this third-party client is registered as.

column.name: registration_type
column.description: How the client became known: pre_registered (console), client_id_metadata_document (fetched from the client_id URL) or dynamic (RFC 7591 registration).

column.name: client_uri
column.description: Home page of the client, shown on the consent page.

column.name: logo_uri
column.description: HTTPS logo of the client, shown on the consent page.

column.name: redirect_uris
column.description: JSON list of exact redirect URIs.

column.name: scope_ceiling
column.description: JSON list of the scopes the client may ever be granted.

column.name: trust_level
column.description: Trust signal shown on the consent page: verified (pre-registered), domain_verified (client metadata document) or unverified (dynamic registration).

column.name: status
column.description: active or blocked.

column.name: blocked_by
column.description: Family block that blocked the client, written only by a block by software id or redirect host: software_id:<software id> or redirect_host:<lower-case host>. Empty for a client blocked on its own and for an active client.

column.name: metadata_fetched_at
column.description: When the client metadata document was last fetched.

column.name: metadata_expires_at
column.description: When the cached client metadata document must be fetched again.

column.name: software_id
column.description: RFC 7591 software_id of a dynamically registered client, used to block every registration of one product.

column.name: software_version
column.description: RFC 7591 software_version of a dynamically registered client.

column.name: registration_metadata
column.description: Raw JSON of the dynamic registration request, kept for support.

column.name: host
column.description: Normalized host of one of the client's redirect URIs (lower case, ASCII, no trailing dot, canonical IP literal), so a redirect host selector finds the client by index.

column.name: uuid
column.description: Public identifier of the consent, carried in access and refresh tokens.

column.name: fk_customer
column.description: Customer who gave the consent. The foreign key cascades only on a hard delete; anonymization revokes through a plugin.

column.name: customer_reference
column.description: Reference of the customer who gave the consent.

column.name: principal_type
column.description: Who the client acts as: customer or company_user. Resolved by a principal resolver plugin.

column.name: principal_reference
column.description: Reference of the principal: customer reference for customer, company user uuid for company_user. No foreign key, so the schema does not depend on any principal module.

column.name: fk_store
column.description: Store the consent is bound to.

column.name: granted_scopes
column.description: JSON list of granted scopes; narrowed when a refresh finds that a scope filter removed one (event scopes_narrowed).

column.name: status
column.description: active or revoked; expired is reserved for the housekeeping command.

column.name: expires_at
column.description: End of the consent, chosen on the consent page.

column.name: last_used_at
column.description: Last call made under the consent, written at most hourly.

column.name: revoked_by
column.description: customer, client, company_admin, back_office, system_reuse_detected, system_code_replay, system_principal_inactive or system_client_blocked.

column.name: refresh_token_identifier
column.description: Identifier of the one live refresh token issued under the consent, in the form consent uuid, a dot, then random hex.

column.name: fk_customer
column.description: Customer whose consents are created one after another while a transaction holds this row locked; the customer row itself is never locked.

column.name: event
column.description: granted, re_consented, scopes_narrowed, revoked, reuse_detected or code_replayed; expired is reserved for the housekeeping command.

column.name: actor
column.description: Same values as spy_agentic_commerce_consent.revoked_by, plus system_scope_filter for scopes_narrowed; granted and re_consented always have customer.

column.name: actor_reference
column.description: Who acted: Back Office username for back_office, company user uuid of the acting admin for company_admin (empty when a cascade ran without a known admin, for example from the console); empty for customer, client and system actors.

column.name: scopes
column.description: JSON list of the consent scopes after the event.

column.name: client_name
column.description: Client name shown on the consent page; filled on granted and re_consented only.

column.name: constraints
column.description: JSON list of the consent constraints in force; filled on the terms events granted, re_consented and scopes_narrowed, an empty list on other events.

column.name: ip_address
column.description: IP address of the request that caused the event; filled only while the project switches the capture on, cleared by housekeeping after getConsentEventClientDataRetentionDays().

column.name: user_agent
column.description: User agent of the request that caused the event, truncated to 512 characters; filled only while the project switches the capture on, cleared by housekeeping after getConsentEventClientDataRetentionDays().

column.name: type
column.description: Constraint type declared by the plugin that enforces it, for example order_total_limit.

column.name: value
column.description: JSON value of the constraint, shaped by its type, for example {"amount": 50000, "currency": "EUR"} for order_total_limit.

column.name: fk_agentic_commerce_consent_event
column.description: Latest terms event (granted, re_consented or scopes_narrowed) of the consent when the order was placed. Null only after the consent was removed by a hard customer delete.

column.name: token_hash
column.description: SHA-256 hash of the hand-off token, in lower-case hex. The token itself is never stored.

column.name: quote_uuid
column.description: Uuid of the cart the token opens.

column.name: principal_type
column.description: Principal type of the consent when the token was issued.

column.name: principal_reference
column.description: Principal reference of the consent when the token was issued; the only principal that may redeem the token.

column.name: fk_store
column.description: Store of the consent; the token is redeemed only in this store.

column.name: used_at
column.description: When the token was redeemed; a redeemed token is never redeemed again.
